skill_title: Read household bills, till slips and bank statements

_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DOCUMENT_FIELD: Reads the wrong field from a structured document.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DEBIT_CREDIT_DIRECTION: Confuses direction (debit as money in, etc.).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_DEBIT_CREDIT_COLUMN: Reads the wrong column on a bank statement.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_BALANCE_RUNNING: Fails to update running balance correctly when verifying.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_BLOCK_FLAT: Treats a stepped/block tariff as a single flat rate.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_TARIFF_BAND_BOUNDARY: Confuses which side of a band boundary a value falls on.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_INCREASE: Forgets to add VAT back to subtotal.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_REVERSE_NAIVE: Subtracts a % of an inclusive total instead of dividing by (1 + r/100).
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_PERCENT_BASE_INVERTED: Uses the wrong base when computing what % one number is of another.
_error_signal_vocabulary.ERR_RATE_USE_OPERATION: Uses the wrong operation when applying a rate.
